perclos._comment: Percentage of eyes-CLOSED time over a rolling window is the standard drowsiness metric. window_frames assumes ~15fps (Lite tier target_fps) -> ~3s window. threshold=0.7 means drowsy confirmed once eyes were closed in 70%+ of observed frames in that window.

seatbelt._comment: Inverted from PPE's vest logic: violation = Seatbelt NOT detected for this many consecutive frames.
